summary: Exposed knife and an unanchored floor runner present clear kitchen hazards.

hazards.title: Exposed Knife on Counter
hazards.detail: Large chef's knife left loose on countertop edge risks severe cuts.
fixSteps: Store knife in a block, magnetic strip, or sheathed in a drawer.
Move sharp utensils away from countertop edges when not in use.

hazards.title: Loose Floor Runner
hazards.detail: Kitchen runner rug without grip backing can shift and cause trips.
fixSteps: Place a non-skid rubber rug pad directly underneath the runner.
Ensure edges lie flat against the flooring to prevent catching feet.

hazards.title: Towel on Oven Handle
hazards.detail: Hanging dish towel near oven heating elements poses a mild burn risk.
fixSteps: Hang towels away from heated cooking appliances.
Keep stove area clear of flammable cloth items.

products.reason: Prevents kitchen runner from sliding and bunching.
